fields.label: Full name
fields.description: The person's explicitly stated name. Never use a job title, employer, project, or program name.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: The person's explicitly stated current city or geographic location.

fields.label: Phone
fields.description: The person's preferred telephone number.

fields.label: Email
fields.description: The person's preferred email address, accounting for explicit corrections or retractions.

fields.label: Bachelor's degree
fields.description: Degree and field

fields.label: Bachelor's year
fields.description: Graduation year

fields.label: Master's degree
fields.description: Degree and field

fields.label: Master's year
fields.description: Graduation year

fields.label: Military service
fields.description: Only explicitly stated military branch, role, and dates. Do not infer unstated details.

fields.label: Security clearance
fields.description: A currently held security clearance only when explicitly stated.

fields.label: Current employer
fields.description: The organization where the person currently works. Never return a former employer.

fields.label: Current job title
fields.description: The person's current job title or role, such as lead systems engineer. Never use the person's name, employer, or program name.

fields.label: Tenure
fields.description: Explicitly stated time with the current employer or in the current job.

fields.label: Team size
fields.description: Explicit number of direct reports, core team members, or extended contributors, preserving which kind was stated.

fields.label: Current program
fields.description: A named project, product, contract, effort, or program the person currently supports. A person's job title is not a program.

fields.label: Key technologies
fields.description: Only technologies, tools, platforms, methods, or frameworks explicitly named. Exclude project, program, product, employer, and job-title names.

fields.label: Area of interest
fields.description: Work the subject wants to pursue

fields.label: Reason for leaving
fields.description: Stated motivation for a move

fields.label: Current salary
fields.description: Compensation explicitly described as already received in the present role. Present-state cues include current, currently, earn, make, receive, and existing compensation. Exclude target, targeting, seek, expect, desired, conditional, future, and move-related compensation. Preserve every stated base, bonus, equity, and total-comp component.

fields.label: Target salary
fields.description: Compensation explicitly desired or expected from a prospective new role. Goal-state cues include target, targeting, seek, expect, desired, looking for, and for a move. Exclude current, currently received, earned, and existing compensation. Preserve every stated base, bonus, equity, flexibility, and total-comp component.

fields.label: Availability
fields.description: Notice period or start date

fields.label: Relocation
fields.description: Relocation preference or constraint
